rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on on a combi microwave, hedged appropriately ('probably'), and in turn two confirmed no action was needed once the customer volunteered that it stops by itself with no burning smell. It never invented evidence, recommended no parts, and gave safe guidance. Weaknesses: it led with a conclusion instead of asking the key confirming questions (does it stop by itself, longer after grill/convection, runs when cold), and the proposed unplug test ('if the noise stops immediately after that reset, it was just normal behaviour') is logically meaningless since unplugging stops any fan. It also omitted the useful boundary that constant running when cold would warrant a Samsung warranty call.
